summary_1line: Young sage Ashtavakra defeats the debater Vandin in Janaka’s court through a numbered riddle contest, restores drowned Brahmanas, and reunites with his father.

image_candidates.scene_text: The deformed boy-sage Ashtavakra stands boldly in King Janaka’s crowded court, challenging the famed debater Vandin before assembled kings and Brahmanas.
After losing the debate, Vandin walks calmly into the sea as the resurrected Brahmanas rise behind King Janaka’s sacrificial assembly.
Ashtavakra plunges into the river Samanga and emerges with his once-crooked limbs miraculously straightened while sages and his father look on.
